Divya Yadav
Senior Vue.js Developer | Bangalore
divya.yadav412@example.com | +91 9437808488

Senior frontend engineer focused on building performant, maintainable Vue.js applications and component libraries. Strong track record delivering user-facing features, improving load times and developer velocity across Nuxt.js-based products. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Bangalore only. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience
Ledgerly, Jan 2020 - Present
Senior Vue.js Developer — Remote

- Designed and maintained a reusable Vue.js component library (buttons, forms, data tables) consumed by 8 cross-functional teams, cutting feature build time by 30% and reducing UI regressions by 60%.
- Implemented client-side data caching and lazy-loading strategies in Nuxt.js routes, decreasing API round-trips by 40% and improving perceived page load by 35% using JavaScript and HTML improvements.
- Championed Agile practices as a scrum contributor, introducing sprint-based feature flags and CI checks that improved deployment frequency to weekly releases with a 98% success rate.

Pixelwave Studios, Jan 2017 - Dec 2019
Vue.js Developer — Hybrid
- Rebuilt core product frontend with Vue.js and Nuxt.js, migrating legacy templates to modern HTML components and JavaScript modules; achieved a 50% reduction in bundle size and 25% faster route transitions.
- Developed interactive marketing and product pages with server-side rendering in Nuxt.js, increasing organic landing conversion by 18% while maintaining consistent HTML semantics for SEO.
- Integrated Vue.js state management patterns and optimized asynchronous data flows to cut average API latency impact on UI by 30% and improved user session retention.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies, contributed to sprint planning and retrospectives, and introduced automated UI linting and unit tests to raise code quality.

UrbanPantry, Jun 2015 - Dec 2016
Frontend Developer — On-site
- Built promotional microsites and shopping flows using Vue.js and Nuxt.js-driven templates, improving add-to-cart conversion by 12% through streamlined HTML forms and JavaScript validation.
- Implemented client-side enhancements and progressive hydration to speed up interactive elements, reducing time-to-interactive by 28%.
- Collaborated with designers and backend engineers in Agile sprints to deliver weekly feature increments and rapid A/B testing of UI variants.
- Wrote modular Vue.js components and documentation that reduced onboarding time for new frontend hires by 20%.

Projects
- Component Kit for Internal Apps: Created a Nuxt.js-based styleguide and component catalog using Vue.js and HTML examples; improved cross-team UI consistency and cut duplicate components by 70%.
- Performance Audits Initiative: Led periodic JavaScript and HTML audits across products, prioritized fixes that collectively improved core web vitals metrics by over 30%.
